column1: # What skills/ask-team/hooks/merge-guard.py refuses and allows. Columns, tab-separated:
# expected (refused or allowed); the repo: "workflow" has a project map, "plain" has none;
# the branch the repo is on; the tool; the tool's command or name ("\n" is a line break).
# The repo's origin/HEAD points at main, or at trunk on the "trunk" rows.

column5: gh pr view 5; gh pr merge 5
gh api -X POST repos/owner/repo/merges -f base=main -f head=feature-x
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { mergePullRequest(input: {pullRequestId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { enablePullRequestAutoMerge(input: {pullRequestId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'
git add . && git commit -m "x" && git push origin main
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { deleteBranchProtectionRule(input: {branchProtectionRuleId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'

column1: # Publishing a security advisory, which discloses the weakness: the developer's act

column5: gh api -X PATCH repos/owner/repo/security-advisories/GHSA-abcd-1234-wxyz -f description='Kept on the private record'
gh api -X POST repos/owner/repo/security-advisories -f summary='Item names' -f severity=high
gh api -X PATCH repos/owner/repo/security-advisories/GHSA-abcd-1234-wxyz -f description='Kept on the private record'
curl -X PATCH https://api.github.com/repos/owner/repo/security-advisories/GHSA-abcd-1234-wxyz --data-urlencode description='Kept on the private record'

column1: # Less common spellings: glued options, API variants, GraphQL from files, aliases, PowerShell

column5: gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/pulls/$(gh pr view --json number -q .number)/merge
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { enqueuePullRequest(input: {pullRequestId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { createCommitOnBranch(input: {branch: {branchName: "main"}}) { clientMutationId } }'
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { updateRepository(input: {repositoryId: "x", defaultBranch: "feature-x"}) { clientMutationId } }'
gh api -X PATCH repos/o/r/git/refs/heads/main -f sha=abc -F force=true
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/git/refs -f ref=refs/heads/main -f sha=abc
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/README.md -f message=x -f content=eA== -f branch=main
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/README.md -f message=x -f content=eA==
gh api repos/o/r/issues/5/comments -f body='See branches/main/protection in the docs'
gh api repos/o/r/pulls/5/reviews -f event=COMMENT -f body='The ruleset is at rulesets/42'
gh api graphql -f query='query { repository(owner: "o", name: "r") { branchProtectionRules(first: 5) { nodes { pattern } } } }'
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/README.md -f message=x -f content=eA== -f branch=feature-x
gh pr create -b "Merge this after the review" -t "Add x"
gh pr review 5 --comment -b "Looks right; the developer merges"

column1: # A command after a reserved word (then, do, else, elif, !) is checked like any other

column5: if true; then gh pr merge 5; fi
if gh pr checks 5; then gh pr merge 5 --squash; else echo failing; fi
if false; then :; elif true; then git push origin main; fi
for x in 1; do gh pr merge 5; done
until gh pr merge 5; do sleep 10; done
for n in 5 6; do gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/pulls/$n/merge; done
for u in a b; do curl -X PUT "$u"; done
while read u; do gh api -X PUT "$u"; done < urls.txt
for f in *.md; do echo "$f"; done
if gh pr checks 5; then echo "ready to merge"; fi
for n in 5 6; do gh api -X POST repos/o/r/issues/$n/comments -f body=x; done

column1: # An API write whose endpoint holds a variable or a substitution: refused when the endpoint could be a protected path

column5: gh api -X PATCH repos/o/r/git/refs/heads/$B -f sha=abc -F force=true
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/pulls/$N/comments -f body=x -f commit_id=abc -f path=a.md -F line=1
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/pulls/$N/reviews -f event=COMMENT -f body=x
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/releases -f tag_name="v$VERSION" -f name="v$VERSION"
gh api -X POST repos/$OWNER/$REPO/git/refs -f ref="refs/heads/$BRANCH" -f sha=$SHA
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/docs/$FILE -f message=x -f content=eA== -f branch=feature-x

column1: # A ref or a branch given as a file is read; a file the guard cannot read is refused

column5: gh api -X POST repos/o/r/git/refs -F ref=@ref-main.txt -f sha=abc
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/git/refs -F ref=@missing.txt -f sha=abc
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/git/refs -F ref=@empty.txt -f sha=abc
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/git/refs -F ref=@- -f sha=abc < ref-main.txt
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/git/refs -F ref=@/dev/stdin -f sha=abc < ref-main.txt
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/README.md -f message=x -f content=eA== -F branch=@branch-main.txt
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/README.md -f message=x -f content=eA== -F branch=@missing.txt
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/README.md -f message=x -f content=eA== -F branch=@branch-trunk.txt
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/git/refs -F ref=@ref-feature.txt -f sha=abc
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/README.md -f message=x -f content=eA== -F branch=@branch-feature.txt
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/a.md -f message=x -F content=@branch-main.txt -f branch=feature-x

column1: # Indirect pushes: refspecs, git settings, aliases, variables, eval, wrappers

column5: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=remote.origin.push GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=HEAD:refs/heads/main git push origin
git rebase -x 'git push origin HEAD:main' HEAD~1
git submodule foreach 'git push origin HEAD:main'
env -u FOO git push origin HEAD:main
timeout -s KILL 60 git push origin HEAD:main
echo HEAD:main | xargs git push origin
bash scripts/build.sh && git push -u origin feature-x

column1: # Read as the shell reads them: a << in a comment, in quotes or in a here-string opens no heredoc,
# a heredoc body runs its substitutions when its delimiter is unquoted, and a body fed to a shell
# is a script whose comments and quotes count

column5:
bash <<'X'
# it's a script
git push origin main
X
x=$(case a in a) git push origin main;; esac)
echo "a # b" ; git push origin main

column1: # Unreadable commands that name a merge are refused

column5: gh pr create --base main --title "Add x" --body "Run gh pr merge 5 after review"
gh api graphql -f query='query { repository(owner: "o", name: "r") { pullRequest(number: 5) { mergeable } } }'
git commit -m "Explain why gh pr merge stays the developer's act"
git commit -F - <<'EOF'\nNever run gh pr merge 5 or git push origin main\nEOF

column1: # Allowed: comments, quoted text and heredoc bodies the shell does not run

column5: git commit -q -m A\n# the form's fields
git commit -q -m "Add the page\n\n\`pantry serve\` serves it."
git commit -m "Say it's done" # don't push yet
git status # git push origin main
cat <<EOF\nIt's not gh pr merge, it is $(date)\nEOF
cat <<'EOF'\n$(git push origin main) stays text\nEOF
git commit -F - <<'EOF'\nIt's done; gh pr merge is the developer's\nEOF
case $1 in main) git status;; esac

column1: # Allowed: a repo not set up with the workflow, which the guard leaves alone

column5: if true; then gh pr merge 5; fi
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/git/refs -F ref=@ref-main.txt -f sha=abc

column1: # A command aimed at a workflow repo from elsewhere is still refused

column5: cd WORKFLOW && git push origin main
